name: inference
description: Local image models server (Python, diffusers): FLUX.2 klein, Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, FLUX 3 klein. Managed with uv.

scripts.setup: uv sync && pnpm run setup:flux && pnpm run setup:qwen && pnpm run setup:flux3 && pnpm run setup:upscale
scripts.setup:loras: uv run python -c 'import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import loras; loras.download_all()'
scripts.setup:qwen: uv run python -c 'import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import qwen_gguf; qwen_gguf.download_all()'
scripts.setup:flux3: uv run python -c 'import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import flux3_gguf; flux3_gguf.download_all()'
scripts.setup:upscale: uv tool install --python 3.13 mlx-gen --with 'pillow<12.2' && uv run python -c 'import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import upscalers; upscalers.download_all()'
scripts.setup:qwen-base: uv run python -c 'import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import qwen_gguf; qwen_gguf.download_all("base")'
